messages:
Alyssa Chen: Heads-up  OrchidAI renewal prep. They asked for a short SLA pack (30d uptime, p95 trend), a clear credit calc example, and confirmation whether onboarding gaps affect their credit eligibility. @Raj can you pull the 30d export? @Emma please check if the p95 jump on 2026-04-07 was deployment or infra. Need a customer-ready one-pager by EOD.

Raj Patel: Pulling now. Quick headline: 30d uptime 99.954%, p50 ~58ms, p95 ~190ms. Notable p95 excursion on 2026-04-07 02:45 UTC. Uploading CSV snippet and chart link.

Emma Rivera: 04/07 spike matches a background node replacement wave in their Dedicated fleet that temporarily increased KV-cache misses and scheduling jitter. No model changes at that time. We applied a staged drain fix to reduce tail latency.

Mike O'Neill: Contract SLOs for OrchidAI: monthly uptime 99.96%; p95 latency <=180ms. Credit policy: formal credit triggers if >1% of minutes in the billing month breach latency SLO OR monthly uptime < SLO. Preliminary numbers show OrchidAI had ~1.05% of minutes above p95 in April so they meet the latency-trigger.

Sasha Lin: Renewal enablement note: OrchidAI is sensitive to credits — they view it as a quality signal. They also flagged two incomplete onboarding items (alerting and runbook walkthrough). They expect mitigations before signing.

Alyssa Chen: Actions: (1) Raj  attach full CSV + a tiny chart, (2) Emma  2-sentence RCA for the customer slide, (3) Mike  formal credit calc and suggested concession, (4) Sasha  draft the customer one-pager and list remaining onboarding steps with owners. Meeting Thurs 11:30 PT to review.

Raj Patel: CSV snippet + chart: https://redwood.internal/metrics/orchidai/2034567890
CSV snippet:
```
date,p50_ms,p95_ms,minutes_over_p95_pct,uptime_pct
2026-03-01,55,165,0.1,100
2026-04-07,59,310,2.6,99.96
2026-04-08,57,185,0.8,99.97
2026-04-30,58,178,0.5,99.95
```
Full export in shared drive.

Emma Rivera: RCA blurb for the deck:
"On 2026-04-07 OrchidAI experienced elevated p95 latency due to a fleet-wide node replacement that caused KV-cache churn and temporary scheduling jitter. Immediate action: staged drain and cache priming; long-term: node replacement sequencing and pre-warm cache step in maintenance playbook. Patch rolled 2026-04-09."

Mike O'Neill: Credit calc (prelim): contract monthly fee $42,000; per contract formula yields a prorated 3% invoice credit for April based on minutes-over-threshold. Legal review pending to confirm exact wording. Recommendation: include the automatic credit in the deck and offer one additional month of free "onboarding hours" (2 premium hours) as a goodwill concession to secure renewal.

legal-bot: Contract check: OrchidAI SOW references latency credit formula for latency breaches >1% minutes. Verify minutes calc source is telemetry export.

Sasha Lin: I support offering 2 premium onboarding hours as a one-time goodwill gesture, contingent on signing within 21 days. That covers the alerting and runbook walkthrough. I'll draft the one-pager and mark the credit as "automatic per contract" and the onboarding hours as "optional goodwill".

Alyssa Chen: Thanks. Please post the finalized one-pager and the internal action queue here before the Thurs 11:30 PT review. If anything changes, flag it in-thread.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: OrchidAI SLA & renewal prep  Thursday 11:30 AM PT (invite sent).
